# Paper Trail

Paper Trail is a private, local-first Gmail Takeout MBOX viewer at https://mbox-takeout-viewer.sociobot.in.

It streams MBOX files in the browser, builds a local search index, renders MIME messages in a sandbox, downloads attachments, and exports original EML files. Email data is never uploaded. The free tier supports exports of up to 1,000 selected messages; a $19 one-time license unlocks larger exports.

- Privacy: https://mbox-takeout-viewer.sociobot.in/privacy/
- Terms: https://mbox-takeout-viewer.sociobot.in/terms/
